style.still: Dark architectural photography of enterprise compute infrastructure. Near-black blue-grey ground, matte surfaces, a shallow haze, one motivated light source per frame. Accent light only in lavender, cyan, emerald and amber gold, used sparingly as thin lines, status LEDs and rim light. 35mm lens, low angle, deep perspective, fine film grain, restrained contrast, wide dynamic range. All hardware is generic and unbranded. No people, no text, no logos, no readable screens.
style.edit: Keep the composition, the vanishing point, the placement of every light and the colour of every light exactly as in the source image. Change only the rendering.
style.video: One continuous motion, one camera path, no cuts. Quiet room tone, no music.
style.video_from_text: Near-black blue-grey ground, matte surfaces, a shallow haze. Accent light only in lavender, cyan, emerald and amber gold, as thin lines, status lights and rim light. 35mm lens, fine film grain, restrained contrast. All hardware is generic and unbranded. No people, no text, no logos, no readable screens. One continuous motion, one camera path, no cuts. Quiet room tone, no music.

never: The Avarok logo or wordmark. The lockup is vector artwork and is composited in an editor, never generated.
Product UI. Every screen on the site is a recording of the product mockup. A generated dashboard is a fabricated product claim.
Readable text of any kind, numbers included. Text is set in the editor in IBM Plex.
Vendor logos, product designs that identify a vendor, military insignia, flags, government seals, real buildings.
People with visible faces. Hands and silhouettes are acceptable when a shot needs scale.
Anything that implies a named customer: a bank's signage, a hospital's name, an agency's badge.

shots.prompt: A long datacenter aisle between two rows of black server racks, seen from a low centre position, racks receding to a single vanishing point. Hundreds of small status LEDs, mostly emerald with a few cyan and rare amber. A thin cyan light strip runs down the centre of the polished concrete floor. Cool haze near the ceiling, perforated rack doors, overhead cable trays.
shots.keep: Symmetric, the vanishing point just above centre, floor reflections visible, no glare that reads as white.
shots.alt: A dark datacenter aisle with rows of racks receding to a vanishing point, status lights in green and cyan.

shots.prompt: A sealed server room seen from a dark corridor through a floor to ceiling glass wall. Inside, one rack row lit in cyan, a closed brushed steel door with a heavy handle and no signage, no cables crossing the threshold. The corridor side is almost black, the room glows softly, faint reflections on the glass.
shots.keep: The door is visibly closed and nothing crosses the glass. It should read as isolated, not as abandoned.
shots.alt: A sealed server room behind a glass wall, lit in cyan, seen from a dark corridor.

shots.prompt: A compact unbranded metal desktop compute box, the size of a thick book, on a dark wooden desk beside a closed laptop and a single network cable. One small status light on the box glows lavender, lavender rim light along its top edge, a window at night far out of focus behind it. Macro product photography, shallow depth of field.
shots.keep: The box is plain: no grille pattern, badge or colour that identifies a real product.
shots.alt: A small desktop compute box on a dark desk with a lavender status light.

shots.prompt: A vault-like corridor of brushed steel and dark stone leading to a rack row behind a fine steel mesh cage. Warm amber gold accent light along the floor edge and on the cage frame, cool emerald status LEDs on the racks inside. Heavy, quiet, precise, like a private bank's lower floor.
shots.keep: No currency, no tickers, no screens. The cage reads as custody, not as a prison.
shots.alt: A steel corridor leading to server racks behind a mesh cage, lit in amber gold.

shots.prompt: A clean hospital service corridor at night with pale matte walls gone dark blue-grey, leading to a small on-premises compute room behind a frosted glass door. A soft emerald glow through the frosted glass, one emerald indicator beside the door, a polished floor with a long reflection.
shots.keep: No patients, no beds, no medical imagery, no red cross. It is the building's infrastructure, not its wards.
shots.alt: A hospital service corridor at night leading to a compute room glowing green behind frosted glass.

shots.prompt: A windowless secure facility corridor in raw concrete and dark steel, a thick door standing closed at the end, a rack room visible through a narrow reinforced window in the door. Cyan light from inside, a single amber indicator above the frame, conduit running along the ceiling.
shots.keep: No insignia, no flags, no seals, no uniforms, no signage. Austere, not menacing.
shots.alt: A concrete secure facility corridor with a closed steel door and cyan light from a rack room beyond.

shots.prompt: A law library aisle of dark wood shelves and bound volumes that becomes, halfway down its length, an aisle of black server racks, the two sharing one vanishing point. Lavender accent light along the shelf edges carrying through as lavender status lights on the racks. Warm practical lamp glow far behind.
shots.keep: The transition from shelves to racks is the whole idea and must be legible at thumbnail size. Book spines carry no readable titles.
shots.alt: A law library aisle whose shelves turn into server racks, lit in lavender.

shots.prompt: A vast data hall seen from a raised gantry, dozens of rack rows running to the horizon under a grid of overhead cable trays. Thin cyan light lines along the trays, scattered emerald status LEDs like a city at night, haze catching the light, a sense of enormous scale and total order.
shots.keep: Scale first. The rows must stay parallel and countable, not dissolve into noise.
shots.alt: A vast data hall with rack rows running to the horizon under cyan lit cable trays.

shots.prompt: A research bench at night. A bare unbranded accelerator board on an open test stand with a plain heat sink, probe leads clipped to test points, a bench power supply with its display turned away from the camera. Emerald light from under the board, a cyan rim on the heat sink, tools laid out in order.
shots.keep: An engineer's bench, not a hacker's den. No readable part numbers.
shots.alt: An accelerator board on an open test stand on a research bench, lit in green.

shots.prompt: An electrical switchgear room feeding a datacenter. Tall grey cabinets, copper busbars behind a clear guard, a row of amber gold indicator lamps running the length of the room, thick cables rising into an overhead tray. Amber gold key light, a trace of cyan from the doorway to the data hall.
shots.keep: It should read as power and therefore as cost. No warning signs with text.
shots.alt: A datacenter switchgear room with copper busbars and a row of amber indicator lamps.

shots.prompt: Abstract studio still life. Several thick chevron shaped prisms of clear optical glass standing on a matte near-black surface, all pointing right, each catching one colour of light: lavender, cyan, emerald, amber gold. Refractions and caustics on the surface, soft haze, a single soft key light from the left.
shots.keep: A motif, not the logo. If any frame reads as an attempt at the Avarok mark, discard it. The vector lockup is composited separately when a logo is needed.
shots.alt: Chevron shaped glass prisms refracting lavender, cyan, green and gold light.

shots.prompt: Render this as a photograph of a real datacenter aisle: black perforated rack doors, a polished concrete floor with reflections, overhead cable trays, a light haze.
shots.keep: The procedural frame fixes the layout, so the result drops into the rack loop's slot without the page changing.
shots.alt: A dark datacenter aisle with rows of racks receding to a vanishing point, status lights in green and cyan.

shots.prompt: Render this as a macro photograph of a grid of identical matte black compute modules mounted on a dark board, with fine channels between the rows carrying points of light.
shots.keep: Three rows of eight, the lanes between them, and the small lock shapes between neighbours should all survive.
shots.alt: A grid of compute modules with points of light moving along the channels between them.

shots.prompt: Render every chevron as a thick prism of clear optical glass floating in haze, lit from the left, with soft refractions.
shots.keep: Depth should come from focus: the small far chevrons soft, the large near ones sharp.
shots.alt: Chevron shaped glass prisms drifting in haze, refracting lavender, cyan, green and gold light.

shots.prompt: Place the first image, unchanged, on the screen of a thin bezel monitor standing on the desk in the second image, behind the compute box. The screen casts a faint cool glow on the desk.
shots.keep: Accept only if every word on the screen is still legible and unchanged at full size. If not, composite the poster onto the monitor by hand with a perspective transform and keep the generated image for the room alone.
shots.alt: The Avarok Console on a monitor behind a small desktop compute box.

shots.prompt: Status lights pulse in slow waves along the racks, thin haze drifts near the ceiling, camera slowly pushes in down the aisle.
shots.keep: A steady push at walking pace or slower. Reject any frame where rack geometry bends.
shots.alt: Rack lights in a dark datacenter aisle, pulsing with load.

shots.prompt: Points of light stream left to right along the channels between the modules, module indicators breathe slowly, camera not moving.
shots.keep: Flow in one direction at one speed per lane. The modules themselves must not move.
shots.alt: A river of tokens moving through a grid of GPUs.

shots.prompt: The glass chevrons drift slowly to the right, light sweeps across them and the refractions slide over the ground, camera not moving.
shots.keep: Slow enough to sit behind text. Nothing enters or leaves the frame abruptly.
shots.alt: The Avarok chevron field, drifting.

shots.prompt: Haze rolls slowly behind the glass, the cyan rack lights pulse once, camera slowly pushes in toward the sealed door.
shots.keep: The door stays closed for the whole clip.
shots.alt: A sealed server room behind glass, its lights pulsing.

shots.prompt: The status light on the box breathes lavender, a faint reflection moves across the desk, camera orbits slightly to the right.
shots.keep: A small move. The box must keep its shape through the orbit.
shots.alt: A small desktop compute box with a breathing lavender status light.

shots.prompt: Light travels along the cable trays toward the horizon while the rack rows pass below, camera glides forward at walking pace.
shots.keep: The opening shot of the reel. Rows stay parallel, the horizon stays level.
shots.alt: A glide over a vast data hall with light travelling along the cable trays.

shots.prompt: Amber indicator lamps blink in sequence down the length of the room, camera pans slowly left.
shots.keep: The sequence should feel like load arriving, not like an alarm.
shots.alt: Indicator lamps blinking in sequence along datacenter switchgear.

shots.prompt: Thin lines of cyan light travel between three distant clusters of server racks standing apart in a dark void, each line arriving as a soft pulse that briefly brightens the cluster it reaches. Camera slowly orbits to the right.
shots.keep: Three sites and the links between them, nothing else. It is the picture of an encrypted mesh, so the lines must read as deliberate connections and never as a web or a net.
shots.alt: Lines of light travelling between three separate clusters of server racks.

shots.prompt: A dark open plan office at night, long rows of desks with closed laptops and small desktop computers, each with one small status light breathing slowly in lavender or emerald, as if the machines are working while the building sleeps. City lights far out of focus through the windows. Camera slowly glides along the desks.
shots.keep: For the Labs page, where the overnight fleet is described as a direction and not a product. Empty chairs, no people, no screens lit.
shots.alt: A dark office at night where every idle computer shows a slowly breathing status light.

shots.prompt: Extreme macro over a bare unbranded accelerator board, fine copper traces and rows of identical memory packages, a cyan rim light sliding across the heat spreader and a faint heat shimmer rising from it. Camera slowly pushes in.
shots.keep: For the engine page. No part numbers, no vendor marks, nothing that identifies a real product.
shots.alt: A slow macro push across an unbranded accelerator board with a cyan rim light.
